history.summary: Unusually large '1BR' (883sqft) freehold at $1,563 PSF in D12, listed ~9% below the $1,713 URA median, with a robust 28-txn series but a soft 2.2%/yr resale-only appreciation rate. The 883sqft size for a 1-bedder suggests a generous/dual-key or mislabelled layout, and 1.46km to MRT is a real walkability problem.
history.rating_rationale: The discount-to-median ($1,563 vs $1,713 PSF, ~9% below) is the most interesting feature and is backed by a credible 28-txn series — that cushions downside. But appreciation is weak at 2.2%/yr, the building sits 1.46km/18-min from Toa Payoh MRT (poor connectivity), and an 883sqft '1BR' is an odd configuration that complicates resale positioning. Freehold and the below-median entry keep it from Avoid; the soft growth and walkability keep it from Buy.
red_flags: 1.46km/18-min from Toa Payoh MRT — poor walkability
catalysts: Listed ~9% below URA median PSF on a solid 28-txn base
Generous floorplate within the bedroom count
